Aisha (Finance): Heads-up: APAC invoice APAC-2026-03 shows a credit memo mismatch. Net GPU spend inflated by ~85% after credits. PDF: https://invoices.redwood.ai/APAC-2026-03.pdf :eyes:
Tom (CloudOps): Which line item? dev vs prod pools?
Aisha (Finance): lines 42-44. charge logged to `playground-asia-gpu` under account `redwood-prod-asia`, but CM-834 was applied to `redwood-asia`. Looks like account id mismatch.
billing-bot: ALERT CM-834 not applied to charge. Reason: account_id mismatch (expected: redwood-asia, found: redwood-prod-asia). Ticket created: #BILL-918.
Diego (ML Infra): We ran a tenant rename during migration last week. Sandbox pools may have been retagged incorrectly.
Sofia (Accounting): Need original CM request and approvals to process AR. @Aisha please attach GL code and approvers.
Aisha (Finance): Uploaded CM request: https://docs.redwood.ai/CM-834-request. Approvals needed: finance-manager + head of platform.
Tom (CloudOps): Quick fix: can we re-tag usage for Mar 1-7 from `redwood-prod-asia` -> `redwood-asia` and ask billing to re-run validation? Do they accept backfilled tags?
Sofia (Accounting): Backfills ok if we have signed approval and evidence. Backfill window closes EOD Friday.
Diego (ML Infra): Tagging script ready. Need exact mapping and timeframe.
Aisha (Finance): Confirmed mapping: `redwood-prod-asia` -> `redwood-asia` for usage between 2026-03-01 and 2026-03-07. I'm starting approvals now.
billing-bot: Note: Revalidation after backfill may take up to 24h.
Tom (CloudOps): I'll schedule the backfill job at 21:00 UTC tonight and monitor. :thumbsup:
Sofia (Accounting): Once approvals land, I'll create AR credit referencing invoice # and CM-834. Please BCC me on approval email.
Aisha (Finance): Action items: 1) submit approvals (done), 2) Tom runs backfill (Diego supervising), 3) billing revalidate CM-834 (billing-bot). Est. resolution 48-72h.
Diego (ML Infra): I'll post any failures to #eng-infra and keep a short runbook in the ticket.
Tom (CloudOps): pinging #legal just in case memo wording needs tweaks.
billing-bot: Will post status updates to this thread after revalidation completes.
